solid-field.description: A plain authorized brand-color field is a complete valid asset. No imagegen, no reference attachment.

brand-graphic.description: Ambient or brand-material graphic that supports mood or identity. Needs no fictional evidence and no causal transition.

product-proof.description: A verified product fragment or real human moment is the primary evidence.

families.select_when: The current authorized brand guide permits a plain brand-color field and the channel composition can carry the message with exact logo, title typography, and whitespace.
focal_events: one restrained flat brand plane with reserved copy zone
must_not: added texture to pass a genericity test

families.select_when: A restrained atmospheric field supports a section's mood or identity without asserting a product fact.
focal_events: a dominant composition using the current approved graphic grammar
must_not: historical material-depth treatment that conflicts with the current authorized flat/other style

families.select_when: Capture, continuity, or Tiro's record origin is central and no external product proof should lead.
focal_events: base form modified into a second state
one exact vector nib introduced by the channel composition
must_not: historical material-depth treatment that conflicts with the current authorized flat/other style

families.select_when: A verified product fragment is the primary evidence.
focal_events: proof revealed through one material boundary
one product state connected to its consequence

families.select_when: A real or generated human conversation is the primary emotional evidence.
focal_events: one visible moment of mutual attention

families.select_when: The message is about transient speech or fragments becoming a durable reusable record.
focal_events: many soft fragments resolving into one surface
